name: The Lost Library of Gilded Pages

prompt: Lost library nestled in misty cliffs, gold-bound books on floating shelves, pages emitting soft golden glow, a floating reading chair in center, stained glass window casting colored light, ancient atmosphere, hyperrealistic, detailed.
caption: Discover a treasure trove of gold‑bound knowledge 📚✨ Open the pages of the lost library.
